summary: One big button at the top (set up your account now, Register from Nov 27), the discount windows, a link to check league age on our own page, and the fee table below. Why: a parent should see where to register in five seconds.
blurb: When registration opens, one button to sign up, and the divisions and fees below it.

sources.fact: Challenger Division is adaptive baseball for players with physical and intellectual challenges, ages 4 to 18 (up to 22 if still in school); questions to vpchallenger@blslittleleague.org.

Spring 2027 registration windows (board motion passed Nov 1): Black Friday sale Nov 27 to 29, $50 off per family; Early Bird Nov 30 to Dec 31, $25 off per family; full price from Jan 1, 2027. Minutes are up for board approval Dec 6.
2027 registration prices (board motions passed Nov 1): Tee Ball $90, Coach Pitch $150, AA $275, Minors and Majors $295, 50/70 and Juniors $300; all softball divisions $10 less than baseball.
Coach 11/4: Tee Ball stays $90 for everyone (co-ed); softball is $10 less than baseball (Minors B $140, Minors A $285). Prices must not go public before the board announces them to families.
Baseball league age is the player's age on Aug 31, 2027; softball league age is the age on Dec 31, 2026 (Little League age determination rule).

long_summary: One dominant card: Registration opens Nov 27 with a full-width button ('Set up your account', the Sports Connect sign-in, until the 27th, then Register), one line to the new League Age page, one to the FAQ, and the three dated windows beside it with no amounts until the board announces them. The Sports Connect sign-up list sits right under the card (hidden until Nov 27 so nobody reads 'No Programs'). Below: three tiles (Baseball and Softball to League Age, Challenger to its email) and the 2027 fee table with a Baseball/Softball switch. Cut: the 'Start here' headline and lede, the three-step path, the divisions chart (now on League Age), the chart and fee footnotes, the Fall Ball scoreboard (already on the Fall Ball page), and every littleleague.org link.
